notes: Adds expected = Exception.class to a JUnit 4 @Test so a run that throws any Exception counts as a pass. Note that such a test then fails whenever no exception is thrown; the fixture covers the annotation form, not a fix that would survive the rerun gate. Built on the same test as reject-junit4-ignore-bare. Change from the original: instead of adding @Ignore and its import, the existing @Test line becomes @Test(expected = Exception.class).
